$comment: Per-run state shape for the /babysit-prs skill. This file documents the JSON that babysit-state.sh reads and writes at ~/.claude/tasks/<project>/babysit-prs/<run_id>.json. It is BOTH documentation and a round-trip fixture: babysit-state.bats loads the sample per-PR record from .prs and asserts it survives state-write-pr -> state-read-pr unchanged. Keep the example values in sync with the PRD state model. Field notes live in sibling '*_doc' keys under $schema_notes so the top-level object stays a valid, loadable state document.

run_level.run_id: Unique id for this /loop run. Names the state file (<run_id>.json).
run_level.flags: Verbatim flag string the run was launched with (e.g. '--merge --fix'). Read as durable authorization.
run_level.my_login: GitHub login resolved once per run via `gh api user --jq .login`. Feeds authored_by_me.

slack.channel_id: Resolved Slack channel id when --slack is used; null/absent otherwise.
slack.last_seen_ts: Watermark: only Slack messages newer than this are scanned each tick.
slack.enabled: true iff Slack discovery is active for this run.

run_level.targets: Normalized, space-joined seed target list. state-load matches a resume candidate by exact-set equality on this value.
run_level.prs: Map of PR number (string key) -> per-PR record.

per_pr_record.head_sha: Last-seen head SHA of the PR. Drives staleness / re-review / counter-reset.
per_pr_record.authored_by_me: true iff PR author == my_login. One (weak) input to the blast-radius gate.
per_pr_record.explicitly_named: true iff the PR was a command-line seed target (vs Slack-discovered).
per_pr_record.ci_failures: Map of check-name -> consecutive-failure count. Flake guard arms a fix only at count >= 2. Reset to 0 on green/pending; whole map cleared on a new head_sha.
per_pr_record.fix_attempts: Count of Cyrus dispatches for this PR this run. Bounded (default 3). Reset by a human commit.
per_pr_record.blocker_fingerprints: Fingerprints (file|category|fuzzy-claim, NOT line number) of blockers seen. A surviving fingerprint after a dispatch trips the non-convergence stop.

last_review.sha: SHA the last review ran against. Re-review only when head_sha != last_review.sha.
last_review.ci: CI conclusion at last review (change-detector for settled re-arm).
last_review.reviewDecision: GitHub reviewDecision at last review (change-detector for settled re-arm).
last_review.blockers: Count of blocking findings from the last valid review.

per_pr_record.approved: true iff the loop has already auto-approved the current head_sha (once-per-SHA dedup). Re-armed on new SHA.
per_pr_record.status: One of: watching | settled | needs-human | merged | closed. merged/closed are terminal; settled is re-armable.
